datasheet_identity.title: RS5AC THRU RS5MC Surface Mount Fast Recovery Rectifier

extraction_notes: RS5MC is the 1000 V variant: VRRM, VDC = 1000 V and VRMS = 700 V on p. 1.

The electrical-characteristics table specifies maximum VF = 1.3 V at IF = 5.0 A, maximum trr = 500 ns at IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, and Irr = 0.25 A, maximum reverse current 2.0 uA at VR = VDC and Ta = 25 °C, and typical junction capacitance 70 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.
Figures 3 and 4 are family-level typical traces; digitized points retain the family semantics and plotted temperature conditions. No intermediate points were interpolated.
The reverse-current plot uses percent of rated peak reverse voltage; for RS5MC, 100% corresponds to 1000 V.
The forward and reverse curve currents use diode polarity magnitudes: forward current is anode-to-cathode and reverse leakage is cathode-to-anode.
No breakdown voltage/current is published; the rated blocking voltage is not a fitted breakdown point.
omission_reason: No breakdown voltage/current is specified. Curves are family-level typical plots rather than individually separated RS5MC traces.
